title: Anti-Pax Silica banner at Isabela State University ordered removed

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A banner opposing the Pax Silica initiative put up by the Supreme Student Council (SSC) of Isabela State University (ISU) in Echague, Isabela, was removed before noon on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The banner, bearing the call “Reject Pax Silica,” was hung from one of the structures on campus on the evening of Monday, Nov. 16, after a successful youth-led protest in Cauayan City, Isabela.
